title: gui: Diagrams → Directory — an interactive tree diagram of the repo's real directories (integrator; after B5-01 + B5-02)
description:
User request 1 continued, GUI half: the directory structure as a diagram, not just a sidebar tree; interactive (reuses B5-02's interact primitive), real names, exported from the same core emitter B5-01 adds (so the CLI `graph --scope tree` and the GUI menu cannot drift).

Owner files (exclusive): `crates/gui/src/diagrams/directory.rs` (new), one dispatch line in `diagrams/mod.rs`, and the new Export menu entry in app.rs (coordinated since app.rs is shell-owned too; do it after B5-04 lands or hand over the menu hunk).

Deliverable
  * A hierarchical canvas: repo root, then directories, then files, all carrying their real names; each dir badged with (files, LOC); entrypoint files marked; optional dotted import edges aggregated between directories (a flag, default off, stated clearly).
  * Layout deterministic on load (BTreeMap/sorted), then drag/pan/zoom via B5-02's primitive; positions persist per view in egui memory; a Reset button restores the canonical layout.
  * Clicking a dir/file behaves like the other Diagrams panels (selection + detail row + cross-highlight in the sidebar tree).
  * `cargo test -p repowalk-gui` green including pure-layout unit tests (do not fork B5-01's core tree builder: call it if accessible, otherwise build the same way from Index::files and say so in the done message).

GATES: fmt/clippy/test gui + workspace.
